body:
Native intake disposition for the reviewed three-consumer dependency sidecar at W03 commit784ee2541506c914b4c34f091de688d39784d548.

The distinct final-head review corroborated the three complete payloads, primary source scope and33 controls, with no new finding. Conditional Difco Bacto identity for GYPS, the generic Peptone parent prerequisites for PYGS/Marine agar, and every source/form/role/export hold remain. Independent packet: `preflight/w03-peptone-final-head-independent-v1`, HANDOFF `2d97691f4c83391fcd0d83abc97e3139654b57606e9610ddb018131f6b5ea328`, MANIFEST `1d661063f2e5340dceff990b2b7d0a46189bbc80a49ed80091a2be2c4c1c898d`.

The published sidecar deliberately does not pretend its foreign source cases belong to W03’s frozen shard. Native application still needs a published proposal ledger with an authentic existing-owner preimage and full global frozen-case hashes. PYGS and Marine agar can retain their genuine W06/W04 source origins, with the W03 sidecar bound as reconciliation evidence. GYPS needs one additive, genuinely W03-authored native-shaped dependency proposal: the actual W05 Peptone case is causal parent context, not a GYPS recipe observation or new W03 assigned source case.

Before integration, W03 will publish that one real GYPS proposal separately from its unchanged188-case core, preserving the original W05 author/head/proposal/context, GYPS beforeimage and exact already-reviewed payload/primary evidence. No new ingredient identity, source occurrence, extra source case, rewritten history, schema/gate change or coordinator-invented origin is authorized by this route. Ordinary commit/nonforce push, independent final representation review, then actual native prepare and the complete original-object crosswalk remain required. This is source provenance work, not application or release approval.
